race.description: Boxing Day Races At Ballina Mdn Plate
race.comment: MAURIJOY (12) is the top pick on debut after winning two recent Gold Coast trials, and the Chris & Corey Munce yard has a solid profile with debutants. The wide barrier is the only query, but her trials give her a strong platform as she lines up in Country NSW grade on debut. CORAL (11) has the benefit of two runs back and her Gold Coast third reads well enough for this, though she was only fair at Ipswich last start. She did beat MISS D'MEZ there a couple of weeks ago, which keeps her firmly in the mix. MISS D'MEZ (10) has the sharpest recent race figure after a half-length second at Gatton despite racing wide. On the quick turnaround again here and can't be left out from a better barrier. PRESTIGE SOTIRIO (6) was beaten three and a half lengths on debut at this track after being well found in betting, but the 3kg claim and natural second-up improvement hold him in good stead.
